user.title: Power measurements
user.description: Provide the grid power (positive when importing, negative when exporting) and/or the house consumption. Without them, consumption is estimated from the baseline and the declared appliances.

data_description.baseline_power: Permanent consumption (router, fridge, standby…) added to the declared appliances when the consumption measurement is unavailable.

loads.title: Controlled devices
loads.description: Select at least one device. Power sensors are optional but improve accuracy.

data_description.indoor_temperature: Used for the comfort band. Falls back to the climate's own temperature.

appliances.title: Measured or estimated appliances
appliances.description:
These appliances are used to estimate consumption when the measurement is unavailable, and are exposed as power sensors.

Declared: {appliances}

data.name: Name
data.entity: Entity telling whether it is on

data_description.power: Used when there is no power sensor.

tariff.title: Tariffs
tariff.description: A deferrable device only starts during peak hours if solar covers at least (peak − offpeak) / (peak − export) of its power; otherwise it waits for off-peak hours.

data_description.price_peak_sensor: When available, the sensor overrides the fixed price.

comfort.title: Comfort
comfort.description: In winter the house is kept between the minimum and the maximum; surplus solar heats up to the maximum to store heat. In summer the same applies in reverse with cooling.

data.max_import: Tolerated grid import before stopping a device

error.no_power_source: Provide the grid power, the house consumption, or at least the solar production.
error.no_load: Select at least one device to control.
error.appliance_no_source: Provide an entity or a power sensor.
error.appliance_no_power: Provide the usual power of the appliance.
error.offpeak_above_peak: The off-peak price must be lower than the peak price.
error.export_above_peak: The export price must be lower than the peak price.
error.band_inverted: The minimum must be lower than the maximum.

abort.already_configured: The energy manager is already configured.
